content: If you are in Canada and experience side effects from a medication, it is important to contact your doctor for medical advice. Before using atropine, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it, to belladonna alkaloids (such as hyoscyamine or scopolamine), or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other complications. After applying this medication, your vision may become temporarily blurred, and your eyes may become more sensitive to light. Protect your eyes in bright light conditions. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used if absolutely necessary, and it is not known whether it passes into breast milk. Drug interactions can alter how your medications work or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not list all possible drug interactions. Keep a list of all the products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs as well as herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. If someone has overdosed on this medication and is experiencing serious symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, and Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. If you are using this medication on a regular schedule and miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is close to the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Store this medication at room temperature, away from light, and do not freeze it. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. For further guidance, consult your pharmacist or local waste disposal company. This information was last revised in May 2024. It is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. This information is not a substitute for individualized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
